sources.title: TxGemma: Efficient and Agentic LLMs for Therapeutics
sources.snippet: Therapeutic development is a costly and high-risk endeavor that is often plagued by high failure rates. To address this, we introduce TxGemma, a suite of efficient, generalist large language models (LLMs) capable of therapeutic property prediction as well as interactive reasoning and explainability.
